signal: GiveCampus rolled out GC Intelligence, AI-powered predictive fundraising workflows, plus Volunteer Management for higher-ed advancement teams

email.body1:
Michelle, saw GiveCampus shipped GC Intelligence, the AI-powered predictive fundraising layer, alongside Volunteer Management for advancement teams.

New capabilities like that surface more institutions than the higher-ed team can work before interest cools, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GiveCampus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michelle, quick follow-up for GiveCampus.

Higher-ed sales cycles are long and relationship-heavy, so reps burn time on research and follow-up instead of in front of advancement leaders. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GiveCampus needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michelle, last bit of proof for GiveCampus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GiveCampus's reply rate likely compares to other edtech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michelle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Higher-ed timelines are their own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a higher-ed motion? I'll tailor it to GiveCampus either way.
